title: Single Number
summary: Given an array of integers where each element appears twice except one, identify the unique element.
statement: Given an array of integers where each element appears twice except one, identify the unique element. Implement a solution with linear time complexity and constant space.
constraints: Exactly one value occurs once; every other distinct value occurs exactly twice.
hints: A value XOR itself is zero, and zero XOR a value preserves it.
XOR every input value into one accumulator.
Initialize zero, XOR each value, then return the accumulator.
Commutativity means duplicate pairs cancel even when separated.
editorial: XOR is associative and commutative. Therefore the whole-array XOR can be regrouped into duplicate pairs, each contributing zero, and the single remaining value. Accumulate that XOR in one variable. Unlike a frequency dictionary, this needs constant extra space under the fixed integer bounds.

tests.explanation: The two 2 values cancel as a pair, leaving the singleton 1.
Both 1 and 2 appear twice; only 4 appears once.
